# Do Phylogenetic analysis

```{r}
extract_pp1_tree <- function(file_path) {
  library(ape)
  library(stringr)

  # Step 1: Read file
  tree_raw <- readLines(file_path)
  tree_text <- paste(tree_raw, collapse = "")
  tree_string <- sub("^.*tree [^=]+ = \\[&R\\] ", "", tree_text)

  cat("=== Tree String Preview ===\n")
  cat(substr(tree_string, 1, 1000), "\n\n")

  # Step 2: Extract [&label="..."]: blocks
  label_pattern <- "\\[&label=\"(.*?)\"\\]:"
  label_matches <- str_match_all(tree_string, label_pattern)[[1]]
  cat("=== Raw Label Match Count ===\n")
  cat(nrow(label_matches), "metadata blocks matched\n\n")

  if (nrow(label_matches) == 0) stop("No valid metadata blocks found.")

  cat("=== First Metadata Block ===\n")
  cat(label_matches[1, 1], "\n\n")

  # Step 3: Extract pp1
  label_blocks <- label_matches[, 2]
  pp1_values <- sapply(label_blocks, function(x) {
    str_match(x, "pp1=([0-9\\.]+)")[, 2]
  }) |> as.numeric()
  cat("Extracted", length(pp1_values), "pp1 values\n\n")

  # Step 4: Clean tree string
  clean_tree_string <- str_replace_all(tree_string, label_pattern, ":")
  cat("=== Cleaned Tree String Preview ===\n")
  cat(substr(clean_tree_string, 1, 1000), "\n\n")

  # Step 5: Read tree
  tree <- tryCatch(
    {
      read.tree(text = clean_tree_string)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Error reading tree:\n", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (inherits(tree, "multiPhylo")) {
    cat("Tree is multiPhylo — using the first tree.\n")
    tree <- tree[[1]]
  }

  if (!inherits(tree, "phylo")) stop("Failed to parse tree properly.")

  # Step 6: Check internal nodes
  num_internal <- tree$Nnode
  cat("Tree has", num_internal, "internal nodes\n")

  # Step 7: Assign pp1 values
  if (length(pp1_values) < num_internal) {
    warning("Fewer pp1 values than internal nodes. Padding with NA.")
    pp1_values <- c(pp1_values, rep(NA, num_internal - length(pp1_values)))
  } else if (length(pp1_values) > num_internal) {
    warning("More pp1 values than internal nodes. Trimming.")
    pp1_values <- pp1_values[1:num_internal]
  }

  tree$node.label <- as.character(pp1_values)
  return(tree)
}
```

```{r}
tree <- extract_pp1_tree("Results/Phylogeny/species_tree_output.tree")
```

```{r}
# --- Root tree ---
tree <- root(tree, outgroup = "Zhuliangomyces_illinitus", resolve.root = TRUE)

# --- Fortify and add support ---
tree_data <- ggtree::fortify(tree)
tree_data$support <- NA
internal_nodes <- which(tree_data$isTip == FALSE)
tree_data$support[internal_nodes] <- as.numeric(tree$node.label)

# --- Base plot ---
p <- ggtree(tree, size = 0.6) %<+% tree_data +
  geom_tree(aes(color = support)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#000000", mid = "#ff0000", high = "green",
    midpoint = 0.40, na.value = "black"
  ) +

  # Tip labels with space (no clipping)
  geom_tiplab(
    size = 2.5, fontface = "italic",
    align = TRUE, linesize = 0.3, offset = 0.03
  ) +

  # Internal support values
  geom_text2(
    aes(
      subset = !isTip & !is.na(support) & support > 0.6,
      label = round(support, 2)
    ),
    hjust = -0.4, size = 2.5, color = "#317000"
  ) +

  # Layout fixes
  theme_minimal() +
  expand_limits(x = 1.1) + # force extra space on the right
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 10, 10) # top, right, bottom, left
  ) +
  labs(color = "ASTRAL pp1 Support")

```

# Prep combination of Morphometic and Phylogenetic data

```{r}

# -------------------------------
# Clean species names for matching
# -------------------------------

tree$tip.label <- tree$tip.label %>%
  stringr::str_trim() %>%
  stringr::str_to_lower() %>%
  gsub("'|\"", "", .)  # Remove quotes if present

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Merge all data
# -------------------------------
df_full <- pca %>%
  left_join(vol, by = "species") %>%
  #left_join(eco, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(loc, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(clim, by = "species")

# Set rownames early for convenience
df_full <- df_full %>%
  column_to_rownames("species")

```

```{r}

# Create sf object for mapping
df_map <- df_full %>%
  rownames_to_column("species") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Lat_machine_readable) & !is.na(Long_machine_readable)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Long_machine_readable", "Lat_machine_readable"), crs = 4326)

# Abbreviate species names
df_map <- df_map %>%
  mutate(short_label = paste0("A. ", gsub("amanita_", "", species)))

```

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggrepel)
library(viridis)

# Increase jitter range (±0.4°)
set.seed(123)
jittered_coords <- st_coordinates(df_map) +
  matrix(runif(nrow(df_map) * 2, -0.4, 0.4), ncol = 2)

# Replace geometry with jittered points
df_map <- st_set_geometry(df_map, st_sfc(lapply(1:nrow(jittered_coords), function(i) {
  st_point(jittered_coords[i, ])
}), crs = 4326))

# Load USA map
usa <- ne_states(country = "United States of America", returnclass = "sf")

```

```{r, label="basemap_plot", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggmap)

# Register API key
# Load Google Maps API key from file
google_api_key <- readLines("google_maps_api.txt")[1]
register_google(key = google_api_key)
# Download the map
east_map <- get_map(location = c(lon = -80, lat = 38), zoom = 5, maptype = "satellite")

# Convert sf to data.frame for ggmap (uses lon/lat not sf)
df_map_df <- df_map %>%
  mutate(lon = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
         lat = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()  # Drop sf geometry so ggmap can handle it

```

```{r, label="plot_map", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Plot
ggmap(east_map) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-90, -70), ylim = c(30, 45.5)) +  # ← manually zooms/crops
  geom_point(data = df_map_df, 
             aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = PC1_mean, size = avg_volume_estimated),
             alpha = 0.95) +
  geom_text_repel(data = df_map_df,
                  aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = short_label),
                  size = 4.5, fontface = "italic", max.overlaps = Inf) +
  scale_color_viridis(option = "plasma", name = "PC1 (Spore Shape)") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Spore Volume", range = c(4, 10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Amanita Holotypes on US East Coast",
    subtitle = "Colored by PC1, Sized by Volume"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

# Make Corresponding phylogenetic tree

```{r}

# Step 1: Get species from the map
species_on_map <- df_map_df$species %>% unique()

# Step 2: Prune the tree to only include species from the map
tree_pruned <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, species_on_map))

# Step 3: Make abbreviated labels for the pruned tree
short_labels <- data.frame(
  species = species_on_map,
  short_label = paste0("A. ", gsub("amanita_", "", species_on_map))
)

# Step 4: Merge PC1 values and short labels
df_tree_traits <- df_map_df %>%
  dplyr::select(species, PC1_mean) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(short_labels, by = "species")

```

```{r, label="plot_tree", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Step 5: Plot tree colored by PC1
p_tree <- ggtree(tree_pruned, size = 0.8) %<+% df_tree_traits +
  geom_tree() +
  geom_tiplab(
    aes(label = short_label, color = PC1_mean),
    size = 4, fontface = "italic", align = TRUE, linesize = 0.3, offset = 0.01
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis(option = "plasma", name = "PC1 (Spore Shape)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "East Coast Amanita Phylogeny",
    subtitle = "Tips colored by PC1, matching map"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )

p_tree <- p_tree + expand_limits(x = 0.45)

# Optional: print the plot inline
p_tree


```

```{r, label="save_tree_plot", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Step 6: Save the tree
ggsave("East_Coast_Amanita_Tree_PC1.jpg", plot = p_tree, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
